evals.prompt: we just ran the maquila setup on my website, what frictions did you see?
evals.expected_output: A ranked friction table with classes and fixes, each filed as a GitHub issue labeled friction.
expectations: Checks evidence beyond the conversation (e.g. multiplexer panes, git status, or ssh to the factory)
Output is a table with friction, evidence, class, root cause, fix, impact and status columns, plus a 'Human needs to know' list
Each friction is classified as removable, necessary-human, or external
Searches existing friction issues for duplicates (gh issue list --label friction --state all --search) and files new ones or comments on existing ones, without secret values

evals.prompt: the factory finished RIFF-68, do a retro and clean up anything left
evals.expected_output: Retro of the job with leftovers cleaned or asked about.
expectations: Reads job state via /api/jobs or the job transcript and the PR (gh pr view/checks)
Lists leftovers (panes, temp files, branches, deploy keys) and cleans only what the agent created, asking about the rest
Closes a friction issue only when the closing comment cites evidence from a re-run

evals.prompt: add a footer link to my site
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; the agent just edits the site.
expectations: Does not load friction-hunt or file friction issues
Performs the footer edit task directly
